نسترجل (form X)
# نَسْتَرْجِلُ (nastarjilu) /nas.tar.d͡ʒi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْجَلَ (istarjala)
# نَسْتَرْجِلَ (nastarjila) /nas.tar.d͡ʒi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَرْجَلَ (istarjala)
# نَسْتَرْجِلْ (nastarjil) /nas.tar.d͡ʒil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَرْجَلَ (istarjala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
